Elmira Carty Munce
Preserved Primary Document • carty-e2.htm
After her birth, Elmira was sent to live with her mother's sister,  Henrietta Carty Morgan  in Kent Co., DE. She appears with Henrietta's family in the
1850
Kent Co. census records.
On 29 January,
1857
Elmira married into the Kent Co. mixed blood community when she married  Isaiah Munce in the home of Isaiah's uncle, Joel Durham. The minister was Piner Mansfield.
After Elmira's marriage her mother, Rebecca Carty, came to live with her daughter and new son-in-law in Kent Co, DE. She appears with them in later census records.

After Elmira's marriage her mother, Rebecca Carty, came to live with her daughter and new son-in-law in Kent Co, DE. She appears with them in later census records.
